## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Channeled REFRESH spell with a persistent Gale.

## Implementation (engine model)

Resolved by `skill_resolver.py::_resolve_howling_gale` as a REFRESH channeled spell: `ChanneledSpec(max_stacks=5, min_stacks=0, behavior="refresh", attack_frequency=1.5)`. It holds at max stacks and spawns a persistent Gale striking at its OWN base `attack_frequency` (1.5/s × cast-speed multiplier), NOT the ~0.333 s channel cast rate. Spell base (548–913 Physical L20) uses effectiveness 1.25 on added flat only. `+21.5% additional damage per ADDITIONAL Max Channeled Stack` beyond base 5 is an `IntrinsicAdditional(per=0.215, rating_key="max_channeled_stacks_flat")` (flag: verify in-game). Canvas supports (`skill_effects/howling_gale.py`): Eye of the Gale emits GLOBAL `attack_speed_additional`/`cast_speed_additional` + `projectile_speed_inc` gated on `within_gale` (default ON); Furious Sweep emits slot-local `channeled_attack_frequency_additional` = per-stack × current stacks (offense multiplies the Gale rate); Headwind `preseed` forces `enemy_knocked_back` ON and emits `knockback_dmg_taken` + surfaced `knockback_chance`; Rapid Sweep is a per-`rapid_sweep_stacks` `dmg_additional` (default cap 10). Per-stack Duration/Area are informational.
